  Regular Meetings are 1st and 3rd Thursdays of every month
  VICE CHAIRPERSON
  Mike Petarra
  Addressing the Committee:
  NEIGHBORHOOD
  SERVICES   Agenda Items: The Permit Committee considers the approval of
  Jaime Saldaña  applications for permits relating to specific businesses and events in the
  City. Members of the public may address the Permit Committee on any
  BUILDING DIVISION  matter listed on the Agenda by addressing the committee during the time
  Mike Petarra  allotted on the agenda for such comment. Please identify the specific
  agenda item(s) on which you wish to address the commission. In order to
  PLANNING DIVISION  conduct a timely meeting, there will be a three-minute limit per person for
  Sandra Elias  any matter listed on the Agenda. Staff and applicants in attendance for
  permits being considered for approval on the agenda may be requested
  POLICE DEPARTMENT  answer questions.
Capt. Michael Buckhannon
   Public Comments (Non-Agenda Items Only): Anyone wishing to address
  FIRE DEPARTMENT  the Permit Committee on an item not on the Agenda may do so during the
  Brad Sizemore  “Public Comments on Non-Agenda Items” period. In order to conduct a
  timely meeting, there will be a three-minute time limit per person for this
  LICENSE DIVISION  portion of the Agenda.
  Angel Castellanos
   Written Public Comments: Public comments may be submitted via email
  CITY ATTORNEY  to license@elmonteca.gov before the beginning of the Meeting. All public
  Richard Padilla  comments submitted via email will be provided to the Committee and will
  become part of the public record. You may also submit written comments
  PERMIT COMMITTEE  vis US Mail addressed to the City of El Monte – Permit Committee, City
  SECRETARY  Hall – East: Licensing Dept., 11333 Valley Boulevard, El Monte CA
  Ivonne Hernandez  91731. Please identify the agenda item you are commenting on. Please
  note that the Committee may not have time to review written comments
  received after 5:00 p.m. on the day before the meeting.
Committee Members and support
 staff are persons or designees of

  department/division per
  EMMC 5.12.010

Americans with Disabilities Act:

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (28 CFR §§ 35.102-35.104; 42 USC §§
  12131-12134), if you need special assistance to participate in the Permit Committee meeting, please
  contact the License/Treasury Department’s Office at (626) 580-2031 at least 24 hours in advance of
  the meeting that reasonable arrangements can be made to ensure accessibility to this meeting.

Agendas and other writings:

 In compliance with Cal. Government Code §54957.5(b), agenda reports and other public records
  permissible for disclosure related to open session agenda items are available on the City’s Website at
  www.elmonteca.gov/agendacenter. Per Cal. Government Code §54953.5(b), if a recording is made for
  whatever purpose by or at the direction of the Permit Committee, it shall be available for inspection
  while it is available. You may also call the City Clerk’s Office at (626) 580-2001 for more information.

 Spanish Interpretation. In you need interpretation of your communications to the Committee from
  Spanish into English, please notify staff at (626)580-2031 or by email at license@elmonteca.gov, with
  if possible, 48 hours to enable the city to make arrangements.

 Interpretatcion de Espanol. Si necesita un servicio de interpretación para sus Comunicaciones al
  Comité en Espanol a Ingles, comuniquese con personal de la cuidad por correo electrónico a
  license@elmonteca.gov, si es posible con 48 horas de aviso previo a la Ciudad para que si es posible
  se puedan realizar los arreglos necesarios.
